description: Land Acquisition - Korathota. Kaduwela D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, including their locations, extents, claimants, and assessment numbers. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with property ownership transfers and land acquisition processes.
